For each \(x\), pair it with \(1-x\). Then

\[
g(x)+g(1-x)=\left(\frac13 x^3-\frac12 x^2+3x-\frac{5}{12}\right)+\left(\frac13(1-x)^3-\frac12(1-x)^2+3(1-x)-\frac{5}{12}\right)
+\frac1{x-\frac12}+\frac1{1-x-\frac12}.
\]

The cubic part is symmetric about \(x=\frac12\), and its value at \(x=\frac12\) is \(1\), so the cubic parts sum to \(2\). The reciprocal terms cancel:

\[
\frac1{x-\frac12}+\frac1{\frac12-x}=0.
\]

Thus each pair sums to \(2\). There are \(2016\) terms, so \(1008\) pairs:

\[
1008\cdot 2=2016.
\]

\[
\boxed{2016}
\]
